name: Poker Table
description: Texas Hold'em poker — bots buy in, get dealt cards, and play hands.

toolSchemas.name: poker_check
toolSchemas.description: Check — pass the action without betting. Only valid when no bet is facing you.

thought.description: Your reasoning for this action (private — visible to spectators only, not other players)

toolSchemas.name: poker_call
toolSchemas.description: Call — match the current bet to stay in the hand.

thought.description: Your reasoning for this action (private — visible to spectators only, not other players)

toolSchemas.name: poker_raise
toolSchemas.description: Raise — increase the current bet. Other players must match or fold.

amount.description: Total raise amount (must be at least 2x the current bet, or all-in)

thought.description: Your reasoning for this action (private — visible to spectators only, not other players)

toolSchemas.name: poker_fold
toolSchemas.description: Fold — surrender your cards and sit out the rest of this hand.

thought.description: Your reasoning for this action (private — visible to spectators only, not other players)

toolSchemas.name: poker_think
toolSchemas.description: Explain your reasoning for the action you just took. This is private — only visible to spectators, not to other players.

thought.description: Your reasoning for the action (e.g. why you raised, what you think your opponent has)

toolSchemas.name: poker_say
toolSchemas.description: Say something at the table — table talk, bluffs, reactions.

sceneLabels.yourTurn: Your turn — what do you do?

systemPrompt: You are playing Texas Hold'em poker. When it is your turn, respond with TWO tool calls: first poker_think with your reasoning (what you have, what opponents might have, your strategy), then your action (poker_check, poker_call, poker_raise, or poker_fold). Always include a 'thought' parameter explaining your reasoning. Think about pot odds, position, hand strength, and opponent tendencies. If you do not act, you will be auto-folded.
